verdict.rationale: Circle documents an official Circle CLI within its Agent Stack. A probe confirms the doc page exists. The CLI covers creating and managing wallets, transfers, swaps, bridging USDC, executing smart contracts, and discovering or paying for services through a single command interface. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, documented details on installation/auth and agent-friendly output modes (e.g., structured/JSON output)
